title: Jira backlog export payload
description: Schema for analysis/handoff/backlog_export_jira.json produced by bsa-backlog-bridge (Phase 3, US-S9-01). The file is a JSON object with a top-level `issues` array; each element is a Jira REST v3 issue-create-shaped payload with BSA provenance preserved as labels + custom-field hints. Strictly read-only with respect to canonical state; the bridge composes from promoted A70 + A72 + A50 + H1-H4 packets (NOT A71 — test scenarios are out-of-scope for backlog import; see skills/bsa-backlog-bridge/SKILL.md scope) and writes ONLY to analysis/handoff/. Schema-enforced via F5 (dispatcher entry under analysis/handoff/backlog_export_jira.json) so a malformed export — wrong field name, missing provenance, broken Jira shape — fails the write rather than landing as a silent half-export.

export_format.description: Discriminator. Must be exactly 'jira' for this schema. Other exporters (linear, generic) carry their own discriminator value.

export_format_version.description: Bridge-output schema version. Bumped on every breaking shape change; consumers can pin against a known major version. Format: bare semver (no canon-policy hash; the export is downstream of canonical state, not part of it).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this export was generated. Same shape as marker.timestamp.

a70_story_register.description: Workspace-relative path to the promoted A70 the export was built from.

a71_test_scenario_register.description: OPTIONAL workspace-relative path to A71. The bridge does NOT read A71 (test scenarios are out-of-scope for backlog import — they live in QA tooling); this slot exists so an operator who DOES want test-scenario provenance preserved at export time can populate it manually after the bridge runs. The key is allowed-but-not-required so the bridge stays single-purpose (story → backlog) while leaving room for a richer downstream tool.

source_artifacts.description: Pin the upstream artifacts the export was built from. Lets a downstream consumer detect drift between the export and the live canonical state. A70 + A72 are required (the matrix is what carries claim+source provenance); A71 is optional (bridge does not consume it).

issues.description: One element per A70 story. Empty array allowed when the workspace has zero promoted stories (early Phase-3 runs). Order MUST match A70.StoryID lexicographic order so re-running the bridge against unchanged A70 produces byte-identical output (idempotency invariant).

key.description: Jira project key (e.g., 'BSA'). Operator-supplied at bridge-invocation time via --jira-project.

name.description: Jira issue type. A70 stories map to Story by default; bsa-backlog-bridge may emit Task for INVEST-deferred stories with INVESTStatus=needs-estimation if operator requests --jira-deferred-as-task.

summary.description: Maps from A70.Title (already capped at 120 chars by A70 schema; well under Jira's 255-char limit).

description.description: Markdown-formatted Jira description: A70.StoryText followed by 'Acceptance criteria:' section listing each criterion as a bullet. Provenance footer references SourceClaimIDs / RelatedNFRIDs.

allOf.description: Membership: must include EXACTLY ONE 'bsa-export' provenance tag. minContains+maxContains=1 prevents a future bridge bug from emitting duplicates.

Membership: must include EXACTLY ONE priority tier label (level-1 / level-2 / level-3). Maps from A70.Priority verbatim. maxContains=1 catches contradictory exports like ['level-1','level-2'] which would leave the receiving team's import ambiguous.

Membership: must include EXACTLY ONE INVEST tier label. Maps from A70.INVESTStatus prefixed with 'invest-'. maxContains=1 catches contradictory exports like ['invest-pass','invest-needs-estimation'] which would suggest two INVEST states for the same story.

labels.description: Jira labels. Schema enforces (minItems + allOf-of-contains) that every payload includes at least three required tags: 'bsa-export' provenance, 'level-N' priority tier (from A70.Priority), 'invest-N' INVEST tier (from A70.INVESTStatus). Per-label pattern is lowercase + alphanumeric + hyphen + underscore — a future bridge bug emitting mixed-case (e.g., 'BSA-EXPORT') OR dropping any of the three required tags fails validation rather than silently landing inconsistent export shapes. Operators may extend with additional labels post-export; the schema allows extras as long as they match the regex.

fields.description: Jira-side payload, ready to POST to /rest/api/3/issue. Fields beyond the required minimum are allowed (custom fields, components, fixVersions) so operator-templated additions don't break the shape.

story_id.description: A70.StoryID this issue maps to. INV-08 carries through: every exported issue links back to a story which itself traces to claims + NFRs.

source_claim_ids.description: Parsed from A70.SourceClaimIDs. May be empty IF related_nfr_ids is non-empty (per A70 INV-08; enforced by anyOf on the bsa_provenance object).

related_nfr_ids.description: Parsed from A70.RelatedNFRIDs. May be empty IF source_claim_ids is non-empty.

trace_count.description: Count of A72 rows where StoryID matches this issue's story_id. Lets the consumer cross-check trace coverage without re-parsing the matrix.

bsa_provenance.description: BSA-side provenance preserved alongside the Jira payload. INV-08 enforced: at least one of source_claim_ids / related_nfr_ids MUST be non-empty (anyOf) — every exported issue traces back to a claim OR an NFR, mirroring the A70 schema's x-bsa-provenance-rules. Strictly informational on the Jira side — Jira REST does not consume this field; downstream BSA tooling uses it to detect export drift vs canonical state.
